chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from one whom he mentioned, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
What suffices you of the recitation with them is the like of the speech of the النفس.

key_terms.النَّفْسِ: the self; here indicating inward or very subtle speech
key_terms.مَعَهُمْ: with them, in the context of being alongside others

ai.seo_question: How much recitation is sufficient in prayer when praying with others?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning recitation in prayer, indicating that a very low level of recitation is sufficient in this context. It points to recitation that is as subtle as inner speech, which is relevant to the chapter on making oneself hear the recitation.
